summary: A user selling a video game account was approached by a buyer offering five times the asking price and proposing payment through crypto escrow using USDT due to claimed payment restrictions. Commenters identified this as a bogus escrow scam likely involving fake payment confirmation to obtain the account without sending real funds.
user_mistake: Considered accepting crypto escrow outside the official marketplace system
prevention: Complete transactions only through the official marketplace escrow system / Refuse off platform crypto escrow offers from unknown buyers
